level-up.desc: level-up sting under 1 s (steel drum / pizzicato)

wisp-latch.desc: lantern wisp latches on: eerie chime

wisp-burst.desc: lantern wisp bursts: glassy shatter + spectral puff

kraken-squeeze.desc: kraken grips the hull: timbers groan, wet squeeze

salvage-haul.desc: salvage hauled aboard: crate thump + coins

momentum-luff.desc: Momentum spent: the sails luff softly
